models.E0: 5-channel early fusion -> 1x1 Conv(5,3) -> RepViT-M0.9 -> FPN -> FCOS.
models.E1: RGB/Thermal/Event reliability stems -> alpha fusion -> Conv(16,3) -> RepViT-M0.9 -> FPN -> FCOS.
models.E2: E1 plus modality dropout 0.15 during training.
models.E3: E1 plus modality dropout 0.10 during training.
models.E4: E1 plus modality dropout 0.20 during training.
models.E5: Availability-conditioned reliability fusion with post-stem masking, masked softmax, and modality dropout 0.15.
models.E6: E2 inference architecture trained with modality-subset consistency distillation from frozen E2 full-input teacher.
models.labels: TriAir class 0 is shifted to torchvision detection label 1; background remains 0.
